impact_assessment.why: The qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4 profile's code sampling stage is the last unfinished part-run on a core model after the 16K floor work; the app and pendingWork keep resuming it, and the served code settings rest on a pass-1-only search.
impact_assessment.benefits: Complete stage provenance at 16K; a confirmed or revised greedy sampler for code; a committed preset recipe that matches the profile the tuner now serves.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preset recipe and preset README claims; dependency: Vulkan runtime and local model; concurrency: box load, tune-lock; state: installed profile overwrite
impact_assessment.mitigation: named profile backup before the run; --continue resumes saved progress (ADR-040/051); exact answer reuse (G8); npm test and aikit check after; preset regenerated only from the final profile
